name: St. Regis Zhuhai
insider_take: Where luxury meets the Pearl River Delta – this St. Regis stands as Zhuhai's crown jewel with unparalleled views of the South China Sea.
whats_special: The St. Regis Zhuhai occupies a prime waterfront location in China's first Special Economic Zone, offering breathtaking views of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge – the world's longest sea-crossing bridge. The hotel's signature St. Regis Butler Service provides 24/7 personalized attention, while its position in Zhuhai's Hengqin New Area places guests at the heart of the Greater Bay Area's rapid development.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room to witness the spectacular nightly light show of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, and take advantage of Zhuhai's visa-free transit policy for easy day trips to Macao just minutes away.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop bar offers panoramic views of three cities (Zhuhai, Hong Kong, and Macao), while the nearby Chimelong Ocean Kingdom – Asia's largest ocean theme park – is just a 10-minute drive away. The famous Lovers' Road waterfront promenade stretches right outside, perfect for sunset strolls along the Pearl River estuary.
pros: Iconic St. Regis butler service and luxury amenities
Prime location in Zhuhai with stunning waterfront views
Access to Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits
Sophisticated dining options and premium spa facilities
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Location may require travel planning for exploring wider region
